popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (Mopsus and Calchas)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus’ famous contest: Colophonian Mopsus outprophesies Calchas at the wild fig and the pregnant sow — the seer-son of Manto (and Apollo or Rhacius) whose victory kills the older prophet. Distinct from Ampycus’ Argonaut Mopsus.

popCulture.title: Mopsus (son of Manto)
popCulture.description: Founder-seer of Colophon/Claros — the prophet who beat Calchas and, in Pausanias, led the colonization tale with Manto.
